answer.rationale: p99 latency 5x on write path, release deployed 2h ago, traffic at peak. Highest-confidence lever that preserves writes without losing capacity is rolling back the suspect build. Asking archive for memory_b1 (rollback cleared a checkout error spike cleanly, prior build stable) and memory_b2 (regional failover worked but here degradation is already confined to the primary region and failover would risk amplifying write loss during peak settlement; still want the record to confirm failover characteristics before ruling it out next window). Add_capacity, circuit_breaker, and read-replica routing are weaker fits: capacity doesn't fix a regression localized to a build, circuit breaker on payments would shed legitimate settlement writes at peak, and read-replica routing doesn't address the write path.
